items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She liked the musician in Jimmy Langston's band.

ctx.x: I mean, things were the way they were, and she just instilled in me like you have to take a person for what they are. And I think that that happened because my mother went to

school because my mother told me, she said my aunt's husband grabbed her and tried to do things to her, to seduce her. And her mother got pissed off thinking it was her fault. See? So now I can relate to all these women being abused and things because my mother's mother's sister's husband tried to seduce my mother. And so in order to make things better around the house, they sent my mother to this all girls school called Matha (phonetic sp.). And my mother got a half way decent education there. And for that…
